title: Surreal Product Ad — brief
description: One brief = one reel in the surreal-product-ad series. Prompt values in English; *_he fields in Hebrew for the storyboard table.

brand.description: Brand name shown on the product/site (fictional placeholder or real client)

product.description: Precise visual description of the product — shape, material, colour, label. Reused in every prompt for consistency

product_short.description: Short name used in video prompts (keeps them 60–90 words), e.g. 'the MAISON ROSÉ glass perfume bottle'

product_he.description: שם המוצר בעברית לטבלה (למשל: בקבוק הבושם)

device_setting.description: Override the series-default MacBook-on-oak-table setting (keep it for series consistency)

website.description: What the site on screen looks like — layout, colours, hero image, the big editorial word

hero_word.description: Stage-2 giant physical word, ≤6 letters, UPPERCASE (PINK, GRIND, FAST)

letter_material.description: What the physical letters are made of

emergence.description: Stage 1 — HOW the product breaks out of the screen

particles.description: Secondary elements in motion (mist, petals, beans, spray)

environment.description: Optional extra environment notes added to the theme

accent_color.description: Brand accent on top of the series' cream/beige base

hero_shot.description: Stage 3 — the final perfectly composed product shot

tagline_integration.description: How the tagline physically lives in the hero scene

image_route.description: gpt = Yuval via gpt-image-gen · midjourney = manual, from midjourney_prompts.md

typography_mode.description: baked = all text inside keyframes · hybrid = hero_word baked, tagline animated in the typography layer · layered = no text in keyframes, everything animated

font_family.description: Google Font for the typography layer (default Playfair Display)

text_layers.description: Optional override — full kinetic-typography layers (see .claude/skills/kinetic-typography/schema/text_layers.schema.json). If omitted, the builder generates defaults from typography_mode

accent_hex.description: Accent colour hex for animated letters

text_hex.description: Tagline text colour hex (dark reads best on the cream set)

look.description: hyperreal (v2 default) = hyperrealistic live-action look; editorial = v1 warm magazine photorealism

drawn_mode.description: Hand-drawn elements joined with the hyperreal footage: sketch-to-real = the website shows a drawn sketch that becomes the real product (baked into K0/K1/S1); annotations = animated hand-drawn accents in the kinetic layer; both

drawn_style.description: Style of the drawn elements (default: fine white ink hand-drawn line art)

drawn_hex.description: Stroke colour of animated hand-drawn accents (default text_hex)

tagline_y.description: Vertical position of the animated tagline (0=top) — move it when the hero frame's empty space differs

macro_beat.description: Add a calm brand-macro beat (keyframe k2b) between the transformation peak and the hero → 4 clips (4/4/3/4s). Object form: {"shot": "<macro description>"}
